data: For fiscal 2025, Apple reported net income of $112,010 million (about $112.0 billion) for the year ended September 27, 2025, up from $93,736 million in fiscal 2024. NVIDIA reported net income of $72,880 million (about $72.9 billion) for its fiscal 2025, which ended January 26, 2025, up from $29,760 million in fiscal 2024. Apple's figure is the larger one, at roughly 1.54 times NVIDIA's, a gap of about $39.1 billion. The two fiscal years do not line up in time. NVIDIA's fiscal 2025 mostly covers calendar 2024, while Apple's runs from late September 2024 to late September 2025, so the two periods overlap by only about four months.
